title: Hardware swipe-back gesture blocked by scroll-lock touch-action
description: On Android and mobile web, the CSS touch-action: none on the root container prevented the native browser swipe-back gesture from firing.
reproSteps: Open any trip on an Android mobile device
Attempt to swipe from the left edge of the screen to go back
Observe that the swipe gesture is unresponsive
expectedBehavior: Native swipe-back navigates back to previous screen smoothly.
actualBehavior: Swipe gesture was swallowed by touch-action: none.
resolutionNote: Fixed in commit by scoping touch-action to individual swipeable rows instead of whole viewport.

title: Offline-captured receipt photos caused localStorage QuotaExceededError
description: Large base64-encoded receipt photos captured while offline filled localStorage beyond the 5MB browser quota.
reproSteps: Go offline (airplane mode)
Capture 3 high-resolution receipt images in expense forms
Save the expenses
expectedBehavior: Receipt photos stage safely offline without exceeding quota.
actualBehavior: localStorage threw QuotaExceededError and dropped subsequent writes.

diagnostics.stackTrace: DOMException: Failed to execute 'setItem' on 'Storage': Setting the value of 'trip_tracker_state' exceeded the quota.

resolutionNote: Created dedicated IndexedDB store (offlineReceiptStore.ts) to hold offline photos separately from localStorage state.

title: Offline/online toggle briefly signed the user out, flashing login screen
description: Supabase GoTrue client fired onAuthStateChange with a null session whenever token refresh failed during a momentary offline blip, causing RequireAuth to unmount the entire app and redirect to /login.
reproSteps: Log into the application
Toggle network offline in Chrome DevTools
Observe that the app immediately unmounts and redirects to the login screen
expectedBehavior: The user stays authenticated offline with cached credentials.
actualBehavior: Transient null sessions triggered full sign-out redirect.

diagnostics.stackTrace: RequireAuth.tsx:21 Navigate to /login (session was null on TOKEN_REFRESHED failure)

resolutionNote: Updated authStore.ts onAuthStateChange to ignore transient null sessions unless event is explicitly SIGNED_OUT.

title: Member deletion, update, and archiving lacked offline queue support
description: deleteMember, updateMember, and toggleArchiveMember directly called Supabase APIs with no optimistic local updates or offline queueing, throwing network errors when disconnected.
reproSteps: Go offline
Navigate to Members tab and edit or delete a member
Observe action fails with uncaught network exception
expectedBehavior: Member edits apply optimistically and queue for background sync upon reconnection.
actualBehavior: Network error thrown and local state reverted.

diagnostics.stackTrace: TypeError: Failed to fetch at deleteMemberRow (tripApi.ts:182)

resolutionNote: Implemented full offline-first mutation handlers in tripStore.ts with queueSync actions (deleteMember, updateMember, toggleArchiveMember).

title: Creating a new trip while offline silently failed without offline path
description: createTrip attempted immediate Supabase relational graph insertion without generating local temporary trip entities or persisting them to offline storage.
reproSteps: Disconnect from internet
Tap '+ New Trip', enter details and submit
Observe that new trip never appears in the list
expectedBehavior: Trip is created with local ID, auto-selected, and queued for server sync.
actualBehavior: Operation aborted on network failure with no offline fallback.

diagnostics.stackTrace: NetworkError when attempting to fetch resource at insertTripGraph (tripApi.ts:112)

resolutionNote: Added offline createTrip branch in tripStore.ts generating temp trip IDs and queuing createTrip mutations.

title: Back navigation used same-URL pushState causing history loops
description: useHistoryBack pushed duplicate entries on identical URLs, causing back-button presses to trigger unexpected state loops rather than popping modal screens.
reproSteps: Open multiple modal sheets consecutively
Press the browser Back button repeatedly
Observe history gets trapped in same URL
expectedBehavior: Each back button press cleanly pops one layer of UI state.
actualBehavior: Repeated back presses looped on the same screen.

diagnostics.stackTrace: useHistoryBack.ts:18 history.pushState called without unique hash delimiter

resolutionNote: Converted useHistoryBack to push unique hash fragment URLs, creating unambiguous stack entries.

title: Multiple modal sheets closed together on a single back press
description: When an expense review modal opened on top of the expense list within a trip, pressing back dismissed both the modal and the active trip view.
reproSteps: Open an active trip
Tap an expense to open ExpenseReviewModal
Press Android hardware back button
expectedBehavior: Only the ExpenseReviewModal closes, leaving the active trip open.
actualBehavior: Both the modal closed and the trip was deselected back to TripsListScreen.

diagnostics.stackTrace: App.tsx back listeners fired concurrently without LIFO depth check

resolutionNote: Ordered useHistoryBack invocations to enforce LIFO stack popping.

title: Android crash on startup due to uninitialized FirebaseApp in FCM plugin
description: @capacitor/push-notifications crashed on Android launch with IllegalStateException when google-services.json was missing or improperly registered in build.gradle.
reproSteps: Build Android APK via `./gradlew assembleDebug`
Launch app on physical Android device
Observe immediate crash before splash screen
expectedBehavior: App launches cleanly with graceful notification registration.
actualBehavior: Fatal crash with java.lang.IllegalStateException: Default FirebaseApp is not initialized.

diagnostics.stackTrace: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.triptracker.app

resolutionNote: Added google-services.json template and Gradle google-services plugin configuration.

title: iOS build failure due to Capacitor SPM Swift API mismatch on Xcode 16
description: Xcode SPM failed to compile @capacitor/core and plugins because capacitor-swift-pm versions drifted from core Capacitor 8.2.0 API signatures.
reproSteps: Run `npx cap sync ios`
Open Xcode and run Build
Observe compilation error: Cannot find 'CAPPluginCall' in scope
expectedBehavior: iOS project compiles cleanly across Xcode 16 and CI.
actualBehavior: Swift compiler failed due to version mismatch in Package.resolved.

diagnostics.stackTrace: Swift compiler error: Type 'Capacitor' has no member 'Plugins' (SPM version mismatch)

resolutionNote: Pinned capacitor-swift-pm to 8.2.0, committed Package.resolved, and created scripts/align-spm-versions.mjs.

title: Native Google OAuth deep link failed on Android auth code exchange
description: Android intent filter was restricted to token callbacks and dropped OAuth authorization code redirects from Chrome Custom Tabs.
reproSteps: Tap 'Sign in with Google' on Android native build
Complete login in Google Chrome Custom Tab
Redirect returns to app but user remains unauthenticated
expectedBehavior: App intercepts deep link, exchanges authorization code for session, and routes to dashboard.
actualBehavior: App reopened at /login with unhandled deep link.

diagnostics.stackTrace: AndroidManifest.xml intent-filter missed scheme host pattern for auth/callback

resolutionNote: Broadened AndroidManifest.xml intent filter and updated parseNativeAuthCallback to support both code and token URL formats.

title: Mobile Safari 100vh caused bottom navigation and toasts to be obscured
description: Static 100vh layout did not account for iOS Safari's dynamic URL bar and home indicator, clipping bottom navigation tabs and action sheets.
reproSteps: Open app in Mobile Safari on iPhone
Scroll down so Safari address bar expands/contracts
Observe bottom navigation bar partially hidden under bottom browser toolbar
expectedBehavior: Bottom bar remains fully visible above iOS safe area and toolbars.
actualBehavior: Bottom tabs clipped behind Safari browser controls.

diagnostics.stackTrace: CSS 100vh static viewport calculation without dynamic viewport units

resolutionNote: Applied CSS 100dvh units with -webkit-fill-available fallbacks and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding.

title: Member deletion left orphaned split IDs corrupting settlement balance math
description: When a member was removed from a trip, their ID remained in expenses.splitMemberIds and expenses.paidBy, producing unequal share totals and persistent split error warnings.
reproSteps: Create trip with 3 members and an equal split expense
Delete member 3 from Members tab
Open Balances & Settlements tab
Observe warning: 'A split member was removed — update the split'
expectedBehavior: Deleted members are purged automatically from future share calculations.
actualBehavior: Balances calculations broke due to missing member in members dictionary.

diagnostics.stackTrace: settlement.ts:74 members[mId].name threw TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined

resolutionNote: Added automated exclusion of deleted members in App.tsx and settlement engine, redistributing equal shares automatically.

title: Sole Admin account deletion caused orphaned trips with no administrative control
description: A trip admin was able to delete their own account even when no other Google-linked admin existed on the trip, leaving the trip completely unmanageable.
reproSteps: Log in as creator of a trip with 2 unlinked companion members
Delete creator profile from Members list
Observe trip has zero admins
expectedBehavior: System prevents self-deletion if no other Google-linked admin is present.
actualBehavior: Admin was deleted, leaving orphaned unmanageable trip.

diagnostics.stackTrace: MembersGroupsTab.tsx handleDeleteMember executed without sole-admin guard

resolutionNote: Implemented sole-admin deletion protection requiring at least one other Google-linked Admin before removing an admin account.

title: Expense geotagging wrote place names to database violating coordinates-only rule
description: Expense form location tagging persisted location.placeName into Supabase, which violated the database contract requiring coordinates only.
reproSteps: Enable Geotagging in Settings
Add an expense and tag current GPS location
Check database expense record
expectedBehavior: Database stores only { lat, lng } coordinates; placeName is resolved on client.
actualBehavior: Full Nominatim reverse-geocoded placeName was stored in DB.

diagnostics.stackTrace: tripApi.ts sent raw location object containing placeName string to Supabase

resolutionNote: Added coordsOnly() sanitizer in tripApi.ts and ran DB migration 0043 to scrub historical placeName strings.

title: Browser reload while offline wiped visible trip and expense data
description: Zustand store held trip, member, and expense records in volatile memory only. Reloading the browser while offline caused initialize() to catch a network error and leave UI empty.
reproSteps: Go offline
Add an expense
Refresh the browser page
Observe expense list is completely empty and sync backlog count increases on re-adds
expectedBehavior: All trip data rehydrates instantly from local storage on reload, online or offline.
actualBehavior: In-memory state was wiped to empty arrays, appearing as total data loss.

diagnostics.stackTrace: tripStore.ts:369 initialize() caught offline error and reset store arrays to []

resolutionNote: Wrapped useTripStore with zustand persist middleware backed by localStorage with mergeServerExpenses dirty-state reconciliation.

title: Superadmin Bug Tracker falsely blocked access when opened from home screen
description: Bug tracker console evaluated isAdmin strictly against activeTrip.ownerId / adminMemberIds; when opened from home screen where activeTrip is null, isAdmin was false and blocked access.
reproSteps: Open app home screen
Click the '🛡️ Bug Tracker' button in the top header
Observe 'Superadmin Access Required' lock screen
expectedBehavior: Bug tracker console opens immediately for developers, superadmins, and QA testing.
actualBehavior: False access denied screen was rendered.

diagnostics.stackTrace: SuperAdminBugTracker.tsx:230 if (!isAdmin) blocked render because activeTrip was null

resolutionNote: Removed artificial trip-scoped lock in SuperAdminBugTracker.tsx and App.tsx, opening direct access to developers.
